fusions.name: Hoofprint Seal
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target and stamp a seal on it that deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Relay Post
fusions.desc: Sends a sealed letter into the first enemy it meets that deals 7 damage. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Stage Ticket
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Remount Chit
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
